name: mono-social
description: MONO — Minimalist Black & White Social & Group Bill-Splitting App (Apple HIG inspired, Play Store ready)

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client
scripts.audit:deps: npm --prefix server audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix client audit --omit=dev
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:client && npm --prefix client run cap:sync
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && npm --prefix client run android:bundle
